import 'dart:io';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/spool.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  group('sizes', () {
    test('total, fits, pages and within', () {
      expect(total([1, 2, 3]), 6);
      expect(fits(0, 5), isTrue);
      expect(fits(5, 5), isTrue);
      expect(fits(-1, 5), isFalse);
      expect(fits(6, 5), isFalse);
      expect(pages(10, 5), 2);
      expect(pages(11, 5), 3);
      expect(within(4, 2, 8), 4);
      expect(within(1, 2, 8), 2);
      expect(within(9, 2, 8), 8);
      expect(within(2, 2, 8), 2);
      expect(within(8, 2, 8), 8);
    });
  });

  group('the spool', () {
    Directory? spool;

    setUp(() => spool = Directory('spool')..createSync());

    // Takes the spool away. When there is none, its setUp did not run, and
    // it leaves a note in the queue: no test that is run leaves one.
    tearDown(() {
      final dir = spool;
      spool = null;
      if (dir == null) {
        File('queue/lost.note').createSync(recursive: true);
      } else {
        dir.deleteSync(recursive: true);
      }
    });

    test('a job in the spool waits', () {
      File('spool/a.job').createSync();
      expect(waiting('spool'), 1);
    });

    test('nothing waits in the queue or on the shelf', () {
      expect(waiting('queue'), 0);
      expect(waiting('shelf'), 0);
    });
  });

  group('the shelf', () {
    // Starts to unpack a job, which the test of the group ends and takes
    // away: after a setUpAll whose test is not run, the half of it stays.
    setUpAll(() => File('shelf/old.part').createSync(recursive: true));

    test('a job waits when it is unpacked', () {
      File('shelf/old.part').renameSync('shelf/old.job');
      expect(waiting('shelf'), 1);
      Directory('shelf').deleteSync(recursive: true);
    });
  });
}
